definitions.explanation: A wire or cable used to transmit electricity. Includes both overhead power lines and electrical wiring.

examples.japanese: {電線|でんせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{鳥|とり}→鳥：00679_tori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧とまって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: A bird is perching on the power line.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{電線|でんせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れた→切れる：01936_kireru⟧。
examples.english: The power line was severed by the typhoon.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{電線|でんせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{地下|ちか}→地下：03429_chika⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{埋|う}める→埋める：01901_umeru⟧⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: In this area, work is underway to bury the power lines underground.

notes:
{電線|でんせん} refers to wires or cables that carry electricity, including both overhead power lines and building wiring.

FORMS:
{電|でん} (electricity) + ⟦{線|せん}→線：09901_sen⟧ (line/wire)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {電線|でんせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れる→切れる：01936_kireru⟧ (power line snaps)
- {電線|でんせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧ (to run electric wire)
- {電線|でんせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{触|さわ}る→触る：00808_sawaru⟧ (to touch a wire — dangerous)
- {電線|でんせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{地中|ちちゅう}→地中：12135_chichuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{埋|う}める→埋める：01901_umeru⟧ (to bury power lines underground)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Overhead power lines and utility poles (⟦{電柱|でんちゅう}→電柱：17913_denchuu⟧) are a characteristic feature of Japanese cities. There is an ongoing government effort called {無電柱化|むでんちゅうか} (utility pole elimination) to bury lines underground.

- ⟦{送電線|そうでんせん}→送電線：09776_soudensen⟧: transmission line (high-voltage)
- ⟦{配線|はいせん}→配線：07862_haisen⟧: wiring (inside buildings)
